full_page.content:
1935, May
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 346 Cont.
May 8 Ed Collins
Agnes Bowman - 27 - nervous - in Ypsilanti ... good girl ... no chance to get to Mass or.
9 Mrs. Frances Wilson - 35 - incurable - Dr's say - 7 yrs. ailing - sometimes discouraged. Enrolled To-night $5.00 and Souls for $5.
Frank Hart - 40 (May 25th) ulcers of stomach since Oct. 12 last - cost $463 up to May Ist Enrolled in Ser. Mass Assoc'n 3rd time in as many months; proposes To-day in case decidedly better before week to enroll as perpetual member.
Page 347 May 11 John O'Keefe - 65 - "bad" looking tongue - goes monthly to H. Com. - promises weekly for yr and perpet. Enrollment.
Genevieve Belanger - 23 - fears T.B. now in Kiefer Hosp.
13 Mrs. Yvonne Stokes - 38 - husband and 5 small - cancer and compli- cation. Enrolls Today (50c) promised.
14 Miss Anna McNamara - 45 - stroke, high blood pp. etc.
Ruane .... prayed ... for May 5th O.K. Edw'd Collins .. ..
Page 348 May 16 Mr. Gladye Newerry - 31 - seemingly Enemic .... Dr's at sea ....
17 Mrs. Mary Jarvis - 76 - fell sometime ago-thought to be mantally unbalanced .... Asks for prayers for her nurse in sanitarium. She seems now to be less bitter against medals, etc.
18 Kath. Bennett - 26 - very low ( feminine) operation abandoned as hopeless - (Children impossible) Enrolled 2nd time To-day; Hus- band non-catholic-promises to be earnest and get to sacraments if wife is spared and join her perpetually.
Edw'd Collins
Mrs. Sadie Snyder - 35 - operation tumor - Monday.
